headline: Travis Kelce confirms marriage to Taylor Swift
standfirst: The NFL star publicly addressed his wedding for the first time on social media.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Travis Kelce confirmed he married Taylor Swift. He called her his wife in a recent comment.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The couple held their wedding ceremony at Madison Square Garden.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Kelce described the event as the best night of his life and a childhood dream come true.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on their social media pages for any future details about the private ceremony.

caption:
Travis Kelce has officially confirmed his marriage to Taylor Swift in a new social media update.

The NFL star referred to Swift as his wife while reflecting on their wedding at Madison Square Garden. He described the celebration as a childhood dream and the best night of his life. This confirms recent reports about the couple's private ceremony.
